run_experiment_training: run the Experiment class to train a neural network on ancient text contextualization with JAX
build_train_input_pipeline: build a training input pipeline using dataloader.loader_tf with Latin and Greek dataset files
compute_multitask_loss: compute a multitask loss combining date, region, mask, next-sentence-prediction, and unknown-token predictions
evaluate_model_epoch: evaluate a trained model epoch across multiple languages and aggregate loss and accuracy metrics
configure_optimizer: configure an optax optimizer with learning rate schedule and gradient clipping for training
